EXISTS (SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO)

sqlMap.select:
SELECT HR.EMPID, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.CHINESE_PINYIN, HR.STATUS_CODE, SY0.CONTENT STATUS_NAME, HR.DEPTNO, HD.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, SY1.CONTENT POST_GRADE_NAME, HPI.BN_CALC_FLAG, TO_CHAR(HR.JOIN_COMPANY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') JOIN_COMPANY_DATE, TO_CHAR(HR.DATE_LEFT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_LEFT, TO_CHAR(HRE.SETTLEMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') SETTLEMENT_DATE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_EMP_PA_INFO HPI, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD, HR_RESIGNATION HRE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = HPI.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.STATUS_CODE = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.POST_GRADE_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND (HRE.ACTIVITY = 1 or nvl(HRE.ACTIVITY,0)= 0)
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY HR.EMPID,HR.DEPTNO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_EMP_PA_INFO HPI, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD, HR_RESIGNATION HRE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY0, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1 WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = HPI.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.STATUS_CODE = SY0.NO(+) AND SY0.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.POST_GRADE_NO = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_EMP_PA_INFO T SET T.BN_CALC_FLAG = #BN_CALC_FLAG:VARCHAR#, T.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, T.UPDATED_BY = #UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR# WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT HR.EMPID EMPID, HR.PERSON_ID PERSON_ID, HR.LOCAL_NAME CHINESE_NAME, HR.EMP_OFFICE EMP_OFFICE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HR.EMP_OFFICE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_STATUS, HR.IN_THE_DIFFERENCE IN_THE_DIFFERENCE, HR.POST_GRADE_NO POST_GRADE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HR.POST_GRADE_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE_NAME, HR.DEPTNO DEPTNO, B.CONTENT DEPTNAME, HD.DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HD.DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NAME, TO_CHAR(HR.JOIN_COMPANY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') JOIN_COMPANY_DATE, TO_CHAR(HR.DATE_LEFT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DATE_LEFT, TO_CHAR(HRE.SETTLEMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') SETTLEMENT_DATE, C.CALC_FLAG CALC_FLAG, C.PA_MONTH PA_MONTH, TO_CHAR(C.GIVE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') GIVE_DATE, C.REMARK REMARK FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_RESIGNATION HRE, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HP, HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME B, BN_CALC_OBJECT C WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = HP.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.DEPTNO = B.DEPTNO(+) AND B.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND C.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID(+)
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY HR.EMPID,HR.DEPTNO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_RESIGNATION HRE, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HP, HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME B, BN_CALC_OBJECT C WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = HP.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.DEPTNO = B.DEPTNO(+) AND B.LANGUAGE = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND C.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID(+)
